stem: Waste from two different identified batches is about to be combined before required records are complete. What is the best response?
choices: Combine the waste and estimate each batch's contribution from the original plant counts later.
Keep required batch identity and quantity traceability intact and follow the authorized waste procedure before combining or final disposition.
Relabel both waste streams as general waste once they leave the production room.
Remove identifying labels before combination so discarded material no longer carries production information.
rationale: Waste can remain part of the controlled material chain until required identity, quantity, and disposition records are complete. Combining batches too early can erase which material contributed to the waste and make reconciliation difficult. The technician should preserve traceability and follow the authorized waste process before combining or disposing of controlled material.
